label: TP
reason: User-controlled parameter names flow directly into PrintWriter.format() via variable 'bar'. The 'safe' value removal does not mitigate the risk of XSS or format string injection via the parameter name. Disabling X-XSS-Protection header confirms the application intends to render unescaped user input.

evidence.note: Data flows from getParameterNames (source) to bar (tainted variable) and finally to writer.format (sink) without sanitization.
